summary: Iteration 2 re-tests the reported persistence bug + removal of stock/fabricated data. Backend pytest: 58/58 passing (100%) after fixing 2 old tests to expect normalized +91 mobile and 1 old test path (owner mobile now normalized server-side). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844) verified end-to-end: fresh number -> OTP 123456 -> onboarding -> /home; profile shows INITIALS avatar 'TU' (testID profile-avatar-initials) with NO stock face image, matches=0/win-rate=—/score=—, NO performance chart section (profile-performance absent), AI Coach card (profile-open-ai) visible. Persistence PROVEN: signed out and re-logged in with same mobile -> app skipped onboarding and landed directly on /home. Admin (9999999999) sees 'Platform admin' entry (profile-admin-dashboard). Server-side normalize_mobile applied in /auth/otp/{start,verify}: '9998887766' and '+919998887766' resolve to identical user id. /api/ai/insights returns real per-user values (performance_score=null, has_analysis=false, chart=[], stats.* real counts). RBAC still works: admin creates club, assigns owner (owner_mobile also now normalized), owner login gets CLUB_OWNER + org workspace; non-member gets 403 on /orgs/{id}/*. Consumer regression clean: bookings 409 on duplicate slot, games 409 when full, posts/like toggle, cart+order, /ai/coach/chat replies.

minor.issue: Owner/staff mobile was stored as raw (e.g. '9998887777'), while /auth/otp/verify normalizes to '+91...', so a provisioned owner logging in becomes a brand-new PLAYER instead of CLUB_OWNER. FIXED here by adding normalize in org_admin._get_or_invite_user.

Pre-existing user documents (created before the avatar-fix, e.g. admin 9999999999, TEST_Player, Kush) still hold i.pravatar.cc avatar URLs. New users are clean (verified). Consider a one-time migration: users.updateMany({avatar: /pravatar/}, {$set:{avatar:null}}) if the product requires zero stock avatars everywhere.

rca_of_issue: Reported bug: login re-asked onboarding every time. Root causes now fixed: (a) unstable JWT_SECRET + non-fixed DB name caused all users to appear new on every restart; (b) frontend normalized to +91 but backend stored the raw string in some paths, so same person appeared as different users on next login. Iteration 2 verifies persistence end-to-end via API (fresh mobile -> onboarding payload -> second verify returns is_new=false with saved name/city/skill) and via web preview (sign out -> re-login skips onboarding). Stock/fabricated data removals verified: onboarding no longer injects pravatar avatar (new users -> avatar=null -> initials shown), /api/ai/insights no longer returns 74/62/chart — returns nulls + real counts. Additional fix applied in org_admin._get_or_invite_user to normalize owner/staff mobile so admin-provisioned CLUB_OWNER accounts survive OTP login.
